title: Impact of adsorption kinetics on the integration of temperature vacuum swing adsorption-based direct air capture (TVSA-DAC) with e-methanol production
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,879-890
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01395F, Paper
Sebastian Bruhn Petersen, Eliana Maria Lozano Sánchez, Thomas Helmer Pedersen
In this study, we provide a detailed technical assessment of an integrated system using direct air capture based on temperature-vacuum-swing-adsorption (TVSA-DAC) as the carbon source for e-methanol production.
